intro.title: Design DataTable API
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a reusable DataTable API using React with TypeScript. You'll learn how to design a structured interface that defines the shape of data, columns, and configuration for a table component. The core concept is using TypeScript interfaces and generics to create a type-safe API that ensures your data and table properties are correctly typed. You'll work with key React concepts like props and component structure to make your table flexible and easy to use. By the end, you'll have a clean, maintainable API ready to power a functional data table in your applications.
intro.usecase: DataTable APIs are essential for building enterprise dashboards and admin panels where users need to view, sort, filter, and paginate large datasets. You'll find them in e-commerce platforms displaying product catalogs, financial applications showing transaction histories, and CRM systems listing customer records. As a developer, you'll implement these APIs to handle complex data operations efficiently while providing responsive user interfaces. Mastering DataTable API design enables you to create professional-grade data management interfaces that scale with real-world business needs.
